name: English (US)
plots: After years apart, a mother and daughter are forced to reunite when tragedy strikes their family. Old secrets resurface, tearing them apart just when they need each other most.
A retired engineer discovers a signal buried in an abandoned factory. What begins as curiosity turns into a race against people who want it kept quiet.
Two strangers share a train compartment across a frozen country. By morning, neither will be the person who boarded.
A small town votes to erase one year from its official history. The only witness is a teenager nobody believes.
A translator hired for a single meeting realises both sides are lying, and that she is the only one who knows it.
reviews: A quietly devastating piece of work that earns every one of its silences.
Beautifully shot, occasionally baffling, never boring. Worth your evening.
None of it makes any sense to me. Not good.
The kind of film that improves the second time and ruins you the third.
Overlong by twenty minutes and better for it.
I have no idea what I watched. I will watch it again.
Watches in one sitting and the ending genuinely unsettles.
The cast carries a script that rarely deserves them.
Beautiful, cold and completely pointless. Loved it.
The first half soars; the second falls apart.
Seen it three times, found something new each time.
Far too much score where silence would have done.
Not a masterpiece, but two hours vanished.
The ending is divisive and that is exactly why it works.
